QUOTE: splits the code into a high-level and a low-level part ... So a composite code such as `-(high | low)` comes out as `"MODULE - high text : low text"`. A code with only low bits gets only the low-level text.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states a code has high-level (module) and low-level parts and that mbedtls_strerror renders both joined with " : " when both are present.
